$comment: Every stylesheet producer in src — a function, arrow-const or method whose name contains Styles and is annotated to return string or Promise<string> — emits CSS whose rules can be present, correctly tokenised, and still never reach the element: a selector that stops matching, a specificity loss, an overpaint. jsdom has no cascade or layout engine and no e2e test reads rendered output, so test/visual is the only lane that can see that class. check:visual-coverage requires each producer to be EITHER rendered by a spec under test/visual (status 'tested' — proven, not asserted: the builder must be named in a spec, interpolated by one that is, or forwarded to by the producer's own body) OR classified 'backlog' (renderable by the harness, not yet — printed every run as visible debt). Keyed per producer rather than per file because a file-level status let a partly-covered file claim full coverage.

src/git-core/gitToolWindow/provider/styl.note: rendered against the production context-menu markup in both themes; token identity under the sentinel palette, WCAG contrast at rest and on hover (including the destructive variant), stacking, item overlap, and narrow-panel overflow (contextMenuTheming.visual.test.ts, contextMenuStates.visual.test.ts)

the three-panel commit layout; the tab specs render it as part of the full provider css stack (gitToolWindowFixture) for cascade fidelity, but no spec asserts its own three-panel rules yet, so it stays backlog

src/git-core/gitToolWindow/provider/comm.note: the log commit-row block and its cells, reached through buildInlineStyles, which interpolates it at the block's original position; rendered by the menu specs and the tab specs' css stack. No spec asserts the row rules' own values yet

src/git-core/gitToolWindow/provider/cont.note: the commit/changed-file/revision menu stylesheet, reached through buildInlineStyles, which interpolates it; same specs, plus the runtime state flags: disabled items fade and drop the pointer cursor, multi-only items are display:none in single mode, and DANGER_ACTIONS is pinned set-equal to the danger items the menu ships

src/conflicts/merge-window/mergeWindowHt.note: rendered in both themes: chrome against production markup from buildMergeWindowDom (column boundaries on every column after the first, bottom-bar buttons resolving their secondary tokens rather than falling back to browser chrome, both bottom-bar actions readable, pane layout, narrow-window overflow, per-kind action-band tints), and fill/selection layering against a hand-built Monaco skeleton (glyphs above both overlay layers, text readable over a bare fill and legible over word-on-fill, fills AND word highlights sunk below the selection, per-kind tint identity for fills/words/bands, empty and resolved markers in their strong tokens, overlay isolation, focused vs unfocused selection colour, fixture kinds pinned set-equal to the stylesheet's k- families). Skeleton limitations recorded in mergeWindowLayering.visual.test.ts
